answer: An agent economy can curb Sybil attacks using collateral bonds locked in an on-chain vault. To survive a gale of synthetic identities, the network requires nodes to stake capital before obtaining routing privileges, imposing a verifiable opportunity cost of liquidity per identity. Unfunded nodes remain quarantined in an operational tundra with zero influence. However, this mechanism favors capital-rich entities and creates high financial barriers for resource-poor agents.
